summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 7,000,000 of its own ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on 16 July 2026. Shares were bought at a volume-weighted average price of 112.2414p (range 111.0500p-113.2000p). The purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding equity. This is a routine capital return via open-market repurchase, executed under UK Market Abuse Regulation with full trade breakdown provided. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for continuation of the buyback programme.
